limits.en: Core ApexCharts library is free and open source (MIT-licensed charting library)

keyLimits.en: Free, open-source charting library; no usage cap for the core library

addOns.en: Companion commercial products in the same family (ApexGrid data grid, ApexGantt, ApexTree org charts, ApexSankey, ApexMaps, ApexStock) with separate, unverified pricing

cautions.en: The core charting library is free/open source; commercial licensing terms for the companion products (grid, gantt, etc.) were not shown on the homepage and were not verified.

capabilities.en: 20+ interactive SVG chart types (line, area, candlestick, heatmap, treemap, pie, radar, gauge, funnel) for React, Vue, Angular and vanilla JS.
Renders large datasets fast, claimed 100k-point line chart in 29ms.
Part of a broader data-visualization suite (data grids, Gantt charts, org charts, flow diagrams, geospatial maps, financial charts) under the same family of products.
Ships an MCP server and AI skill files for use with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT.

limitations.en: The core library covers charting only; companion features (data grid, Gantt, org charts) are separate products, not bundled in.
No hosted/SaaS offering: it is an embeddable JS library, so teams must integrate and maintain it themselves within their own app.

reason.en: Comparable free, embeddable charting library for web apps with a similar chart-type range.
React-focused charting library covering the same use case for React developers.
Lower-level alternative for teams that need full custom control over chart rendering.

unknowns: Exact license terms (MIT vs. other) and pricing of the companion commercial products (ApexGrid, ApexGantt, etc.) were not verified on the homepage.
TypeScript/Blazor support was mentioned but not detailed further.
